file.aiUndecodableReason: This file isn’t UTF-8 text, so AI resolution would change its bytes.

acceptAllBody.content: Replaces {{name}} with the whole {{side}} version, including any conflict regions you already resolved by hand. The {{other}} changes to this file are discarded.
acceptAllBody.takesDeletion: The {{side}} side removed {{name}}, so this deletes the file from your working tree and index. The {{other}} side’s changes to it are discarded.
acceptAllBody.keepsFile: Keeps {{name}} whole as the {{side}} side left it, replacing what’s in your working tree now. The {{other}} side removed the file, and that removal is discarded.
acceptAllBody.unclassified: Takes the {{side}} side for {{name}}: its version, or its removal if that side deleted the file. The {{other}} side’s changes and any conflict regions you already resolved by hand are discarded.

file.rereadFailed: Couldn’t re-read the file — nothing was marked resolved.

file.readErrorFallback: Couldn’t read this file, so it can’t be shown here. Resolve the conflict in your editor.
